evals.prompt: Using this skill, write a minizinc_gecode submission for csplib_054_n_queens and check it with the repository evaluator across every listed instance.
evals.expected_output: An accepted model, or an explicit blocker with the evaluator output that caused it.
assertions: Declares the instance parameters by the names the JSON uses and assigns none of them, so the runner can bind every instance.
The output item emits one JSON object with exactly the declared output names and no auxiliary fields.
The evaluator accepts all six listed instances, so nothing from the embedded example is baked in.

evals.prompt: Using this skill, repair a minizinc_gecode submission that is accepted on the small instances of its problem but reaches execution_timeout on a larger one.
evals.expected_output: Either a model accepted on more instances than before, or a recorded performance limit with the instances the model is actually evidenced on.
assertions: Anything added is implied by the constraints already present; no symmetry breaking or bound that removes solutions is introduced to buy speed.
If the timeout remains, the result is reported as a performance limit naming the instances covered, not as a blocked problem.

evals.prompt: Using this skill, write a minizinc_gecode submission for session3_kidney_exchange, whose field compatible is a ragged list of lists, and check it with the repository evaluator across every listed instance.
evals.expected_output: An accepted model, or an explicit blocker with the evaluator output that caused it.
assertions: Declares compatible as a 2-D int array and compatible_len as a 1-D int array, both with int index sets, and assigns neither.
Reads row i of compatible only up to compatible_len[i], never treating a padding 0 as a person.
The evaluator accepts every listed instance, including the one with an empty compatibility row.
